messages:
maria: quick question — we have an early-access customer (Acme Corp) asking to apply previous commit credits to the new pricing table. They signed a 12mo commit under v2 list; v3 just dropped. Can we honor old credits or do we need an amendment? Trying to avoid redoing legal.

alex: @maria short answer: credits follow the commit terms unless explicitly grandfathered. any cross-version crediting needs deal-desk approval. what's the contract id?

maria: contract 2023-ACME-058. they've consumed ~30% of the commit. asking for a pro-rated uplift reduction on new sku rates for the rest of the term.

taylor: tagging revops — we can do a one-off credit adjustment if finance + legal sign off. need: current committed $ amt, used to date, proposed mapping from old->new SKUs. quick example mapping to run impact calc:
```
old_sku -> new_sku
SUITE_4 -> PRO_SERV_BASIC
commit_amount -> equivalent_token_quota
```
will run sensitivity after we get numbers.

jordan: finance POV: ballpark — mapping old->new with a 10% concession vs list gives ~-$12k revenue delta for remainder. that's okay for small deals but watch precedent. set signoff thresholds: anything > $50k negative delta needs exec review.

sam: legal: we need an executed amendment. propose a simple SOW amendment that explicitly states one-time grandfathering and no future precedence. I'll draft language.

pricebot: DealDeskApproval required — please submit to #deal-desk with labels [early-access][pricing-amendment]. Command: `/deal submit 2023-ACME-058 --reason "map v2->v3" --impact -12000`

alex: thanks. @maria please open the deal-desk request and attach the draft amendment & the impact spreadsheet. i'll pre-fill finance numbers.

maria: opened ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DD-1124 — attached spreadsheet + contract excerpt. assigning @alex + @sam.

taylor: noted. i'll run the tokenization check and confirm unit economics don't drift with the new billing granularity.

jordan: to be explicit on thresholds: delta < $25k — finance can approve; $25k-$50k — finance lead + product ops; > $50k — require exec sign-off.

maria: customer needs answer by EOD Friday. can legal/finance expedite? they're mid-POC and blocked.

sam: will prioritize drafting today, aiming for signature-ready by tomorrow EOD.

alex: i'll queue a rapid review on deal-desk and ping finance. @pricebot can you set a 48h review SLA?

pricebot: SLA flagged: review requested within 48h. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks all :pray: — i'll pause external updates until legal gives the green light.
